generation_parents.algorithm: At each step, choose the unvisited customer that minimizes a composite score blending nearest-neighbor distance, a residual-capacity fit term (encouraging demands that fill remaining capacity or leave room for more), and a depot-return penalty, with an explicit depot branch when no customer improves the current route.

declared_hypothesis: A modest packing adjustment can reduce long extra routes while preserving geographic cohesion.
